review_text:
I've only used the pool so far.
Did swimming training here during Ramadan, hence it was less crowded. Also there are usually three slots
1. Female
2. Male under 14
3. Male 14 and above

Training plan:
12 classes, each 1.5 hours.
Friday and Saturday.

But due ramadan time, 2 and 3 were combined.
The trainer is friendly and relaxed. He gives time to kids much more which is expected but might be frustrating to some older learners who prefer more assistance.

But nonetheless, I can say within the training schedule, I felt confident enough to swim through the deep end.

Other info:
The place gets pretty crowded after noon and its hard to swim laps. But if you just want to dip in the water then it's fine.

- No heating available in winter.
- You must bring your own towels and bags.
- Open till 10:30PM.

business_address: Block N Bashundhara Sports City, Dhaka, Bangladesh
review_text:
I visited Bashundhara Gold Gym and had an appointment with one of their instructors. I shared my health issues and different types of pain in detail, but throughout the entire conversation he was fully focused on his phone. This kind of behaviour from a well-known gym instructor is completely unacceptable.

I live abroad, and abroad gym instructors treat clients like friends — they listen, they guide, and they welcome new members with respect. But even after talking for more than 20 minutes, I did not receive proper attention from him. An instructor without basic manners on how to talk, welcome, and guide new clients can be harmful both for the gym’s reputation and for clients’ health progress.

I am sharing this feedback to alert the management and inform other residents or potential members. No one should have to face such unprofessional behaviour in a gym environment.

review_text:
The gym experience was very good and definitely worth the price. For the cost, there’s plenty of gym equipment, all of excellent quality. You can find various types of machines, including a well-equipped cardio section. The workout area is spacious enough.

The men’s bathroom, changing room, and steam room are in the same section, and they are clean and well-maintained. There are also separate changing rooms and facilities for women.

The gym offers good workout routines, and while the trainer is helpful, they could be better.

Overall, it’s a great place to work out. Full air conditioned . You can park your bike in front of the gym as it’s located by the roadside, and there’s also parking available within the building.
